name: Oskarn Station 134 EGEO
description: Key Features Caliche-Sealed Construction: Durable pottery vault designed with a caliche seal for enhanced structural integrity and long-lasting protection against moisture and environmental factors. Generous Internal Capacity: Offers a spacious 1,509-litre internal volume, ideal for storing large quantities of sensitive items or bulk goods. Precise Climate Control: Maintains a stable internal temperature of 15°C and a humidity setpoint of 49% relative humidity, ensuring optimal preservation conditions for temperature- and humidity-sensitive contents. Inert Gas Atmosphere: Features an inert gas environment to help prevent oxidation, spoilage, and contamination, supporting the long-term storage of valuables, perishables, or archival materials. Ample Organization: Equipped with 23 sturdy shelves, providing efficient organization and easy access to stored items. Custom Pricing: Unit price is determined upon acceptance, allowing for tailored quotes based on individual requirements. Main Benefits Enhanced Preservation: The combination of caliche sealing, precise climate control, and inert gas atmosphere protects contents from moisture, temperature fluctuations, and atmospheric contaminants—ideal for items requiring stable storage conditions. Large Storage Capacity: Accommodates a wide range of storage needs, from archival documents and collectibles to food products and scientific samples. Flexible Organization: Multiple shelves allow for systematic arrangement, making inventory management and retrieval more convenient. Reliable Durability: Caliche-sealed pottery construction ensures longevity and resistance to environmental wear, reducing maintenance concerns over time. Typical Use Cases or Outcomes Archival Storage: Perfect for museums, libraries, or collectors needing to preserve documents, artifacts, or artworks in a controlled environment. Food and Beverage Storage: Suitable for wineries, cheese makers, or specialty food producers seeking stable temperature and humidity for product aging or preservation. Scientific and Laboratory Use: Meets the needs of laboratories or research facilities requiring secure, inert storage for samples, reagents, or sensitive materials. Valuable Goods Protection: Ideal for safeguarding valuables, heirlooms, or sensitive equipment from environmental degradation. Additional Information Durability & Ease of Use: Built with robust materials for minimal upkeep; the shelving system is designed for straightforward access and reconfiguration. Compatibility: Suitable for a variety of storage needs across commercial, institutional, and private settings. Value: Custom pricing ensures you receive a solution tailored to your specific storage requirements and budget. For questions about installation, compatibility with specific items, or to request a tailored quote, please contact us directly.
description_html:
Key Features

  • Caliche-Sealed Construction: Durable pottery vault designed with a caliche seal for enhanced structural integrity and long-lasting protection against moisture and environmental factors.
  • Generous Internal Capacity: Offers a spacious 1,509-litre internal volume, ideal for storing large quantities of sensitive items or bulk goods.
  • Precise Climate Control: Maintains a stable internal temperature of 15°C and a humidity setpoint of 49% relative humidity, ensuring optimal preservation conditions for temperature- and humidity-sensitive contents.
  • Inert Gas Atmosphere: Features an inert gas environment to help prevent oxidation, spoilage, and contamination, supporting the long-term storage of valuables, perishables, or archival materials.
  • Ample Organization: Equipped with 23 sturdy shelves, providing efficient organization and easy access to stored items.
  • Custom Pricing: Unit price is determined upon acceptance, allowing for tailored quotes based on individual requirements.

Main Benefits

  • Enhanced Preservation: The combination of caliche sealing, precise climate control, and inert gas atmosphere protects contents from moisture, temperature fluctuations, and atmospheric contaminants—ideal for items requiring stable storage conditions.
  • Large Storage Capacity: Accommodates a wide range of storage needs, from archival documents and collectibles to food products and scientific samples.
  • Flexible Organization: Multiple shelves allow for systematic arrangement, making inventory management and retrieval more convenient.
  • Reliable Durability: Caliche-sealed pottery construction ensures longevity and resistance to environmental wear, reducing maintenance concerns over time.

Typical Use Cases or Outcomes

  • Archival Storage: Perfect for museums, libraries, or collectors needing to preserve documents, artifacts, or artworks in a controlled environment.
  • Food and Beverage Storage: Suitable for wineries, cheese makers, or specialty food producers seeking stable temperature and humidity for product aging or preservation.
  • Scientific and Laboratory Use: Meets the needs of laboratories or research facilities requiring secure, inert storage for samples, reagents, or sensitive materials.
  • Valuable Goods Protection: Ideal for safeguarding valuables, heirlooms, or sensitive equipment from environmental degradation.

Additional Information

  • Durability & Ease of Use: Built with robust materials for minimal upkeep; the shelving system is designed for straightforward access and reconfiguration.
  • Compatibility: Suitable for a variety of storage needs across commercial, institutional, and private settings.
  • Value: Custom pricing ensures you receive a solution tailored to your specific storage requirements and budget.

For questions about installation, compatibility with specific items, or to request a tailored quote, please contact us directly.
